Use case: identity-preserve. Production sprite sheet for an existing 16-bit fighting game. The attached image is the EXACT canonical character. Preserve his lean narrow body, angular long narrow face, thin jaw, small closed mouth, stern unsmiling expression, deep-set eyes, neat short combed black hair, narrow shoulders and fitted navy blue suit, white shirt, slim red tie, small gold lapel pin, black shoes. He must stay the SAME THIN MAN in EVERY pose. Do not make his cheeks round, jaw wide, neck thick, shoulders broad, body bulky, muscular or inflated. Do not smile. Match exact pixel style and fine shading of reference. Anatomical head size and limb thickness consistent across ALL frames, same camera and scale. Transparent background. Full-body sprites in a strict regular 4-column 5-row grid, 20 cells, ample empty gutters, each body entirely inside its cell with both shoes unclipped. No labels, text, bubbles, props, animals, shadows, FX or background. All face RIGHT in 3/4 fighting view, even backward walk.
Row1: 4 sequential forward walking poses, hands lowered beside slim torso and subtle arm swing, natural alternating legs.
Row2: 4 sequential backward walking poses still facing right, light guard hands, alternating backward steps.
Row3: 4 sequential summoning gestures: guard gathering energy; left hand opening near chest; right arm pointing forward; both hands extending forward. Narrow face identical to reference.
Row4: 4 jump-kick poses: slight knee bend preparation; rising knee; flying kick with one leg fully extended horizontally forward and other tucked; retracting kick with bent knees. Body narrows naturally when side-on, never grows thicker.
Row5: landing from kick; low wide-stance energy charge fists at waist; energy charge same stance fists lifting slightly chest open (same skinny shoulders); neutral recovery guard. Each pose is a single solo man no opponent. High-quality crisp detailed arcade pixel art, not low-resolution simplification.

Precise sprite-sheet edit. Image 1 is the sheet to edit, image 2 is the exact canonical fighter reference. Keep the strict 4-column 5-row layout, all body poses, body height, feet placement, hands, suit, colors, transparent background and animation content from image 1 unchanged. Correct ONLY the heads and faces: the heads in image 1 are oversized compared with the original guard in image 2. Make every head approximately 20 percent smaller in BOTH width and height, keeping its neck connection fixed. Match the small, angular, lean face and narrow jaw, short neatly combed black hair, stern closed mouth and pixel shading from image 2 exactly. Maintain a consistent canonical head scale across all20 poses. No smile, rounded cheeks, swollen jaw or bulky neck. No text, no added elements. Preserve the sheet dimensions and clean transparent gutters. This is a fine detailed 16-bit arcade sprite sheet, exact original face identity is the highest priority.
